architectural_units.name: Client
architectural_units.description: In our case, the client is the user of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Server
architectural_units.description: The server is the software that is responsible for processing user requests.

architectural_units.name: Presentation Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for displaying information to the user.

architectural_units.name: Business Layer
architectural_units.description: This layer is the core of the application and is responsible for processing all the information.

architectural_units.name: Data Layer
architectural_units.description: It is the layer that is responsible for storing all the data.

architectural_units.name: API Gateway
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for the management, authentication and authorization of platform users.

architectural_units.name: Core
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for performing the business logic of the platform, it would be the main core of the platform.

architectural_units.name: Analytical Module
architectural_units.description: The analytical module has as its main function to obtain and process the data of the playlogs, the connections and the actions in platform.

architectural_units.name: API Player
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for communicating with the players receiving all the information corresponding to this.

architectural_units.name: Web Socket
architectural_units.description: This service is responsible for carrying out the communication between the platform and the players, and in this way allows the exchange of information between them.

architectural_units.name: NestJS
architectural_units.description: Framework used to develop the different services that interact with each other.

architectural_units.name: AWS
architectural_units.description: Set of cloud computing services that allows the creation of scalable and highly available applications.

architectural_units.name: Amazon S3
architectural_units.description: Amazon's object storage service.

architectural_units.name: DynamoDB
architectural_units.description: This service is a non-relational database of AWS.

architectural_units.name: Amazon Athena
architectural_units.description: Service that allows performing SQL queries on data stored in Amazon S3.

architectural_units.name: AWS Glue
architectural_units.description: Serverless data integration service that allows us to detect, prepare, migrate and integrate data from different sources.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Streams
architectural_units.description: Data processing and ingestion service aimed especially at data streaming.

architectural_units.name: Kinesis Data Firehose
architectural_units.description: Service whose main function is the loading of large amounts of data into data warehouses.
Communication between the presentation layer and the business layer via HTTP.
Communication between the API Gateway and other services via TCP.

patterns.name: Client-Server
patterns.description: The Waapiti platform is a web service that follows the client-server architecture.

patterns.name: Three Layers
patterns.description: The client-server model uses a 3-layer architecture, where the system is divided into 3 layers.

patterns.name: API Gateway
patterns.description: This design pattern allows only one component to interact between users and the services provided by the platform.
